from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Runtime_Federation(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_runtime_federation"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("action",            "string", widget_type="text", default="list")
        self.add_input("runtime_name",      "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("endpoint",          "string", widget_type="text", default="local://")
        self.add_input("capabilities_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_input("runtime_type",      "string", widget_type="text", default="remote")
        self.add_input("runtime_id",        "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_output("ok",           "bool")
        self.add_output("runtime_id",   "string")
        self.add_output("capabilities", "list")
        self.add_output("runtimes",     "list")
        self.add_output("status",       "string")
        self.add_output("report_json",  "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        from src.runtime.runtime_federation_api import get_runtime_federation_api
        api    = get_runtime_federation_api()
        action = str(inputs.get("action", "list")).strip().lower()
        _empty = {
            "exec_out": True, "ok": False, "runtime_id": "",
            "capabilities": [], "runtimes": [], "status": "", "report_json": "{}"
        }

        try:
            if action == "register":
                name = str(inputs.get("runtime_name", "")).strip()
                if not name:
                    _empty["status"] = "error: runtime_name required"
                    return _empty
                try:
                    caps = json.loads(inputs.get("capabilities_json") or "[]")
                except Exception:
                    caps = []
                rid = api.register_runtime(
                    name=name,
                    endpoint=str(inputs.get("endpoint", "local://")),
                    capabilities=caps,
                    runtime_type=str(inputs.get("runtime_type", "remote")),
                )
                runtimes = api.list_runtimes()
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": True, "runtime_id": rid,
                    "capabilities": caps, "runtimes": runtimes,
                    "status": "registered",
                    "report_json": json.dumps({"action": "register", "runtime_id": rid}),
                }

            elif action == "discover":
                rid  = str(inputs.get("runtime_id", "")).strip()
                caps = api.discover_capabilities(rid)
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": True, "runtime_id": rid,
                    "capabilities": caps, "runtimes": [],
                    "status": f"{len(caps)} capabilities discovered",
                    "report_json": json.dumps({"runtime_id": rid, "capabilities": caps}),
                }

            elif action == "exchange":
                rid  = str(inputs.get("runtime_id", "")).strip()
                result = api.exchange_capabilities(rid)
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": result["ok"], "runtime_id": rid,
                    "capabilities": result.get("received", []), "runtimes": [],
                    "status": "exchanged",
                    "report_json": json.dumps(result),
                }

            elif action == "status":
                rid = str(inputs.get("runtime_id", "")).strip()
                rt  = api.get_runtime_status(rid)
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": rt is not None, "runtime_id": rid,
                    "capabilities": rt.get("capabilities", []) if rt else [],
                    "runtimes": [rt] if rt else [],
                    "status": rt.get("status", "unknown") if rt else "not_found",
                    "report_json": json.dumps(rt or {}),
                }

            elif action == "deregister":
                rid = str(inputs.get("runtime_id", "")).strip()
                ok  = api.deregister_runtime(rid)
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": ok, "runtime_id": rid,
                    "capabilities": [], "runtimes": api.list_runtimes(),
                    "status": "deregistered" if ok else "not_found",
                    "report_json": json.dumps({"action": "deregister", "ok": ok}),
                }

            else:  # list
                rt_type = str(inputs.get("runtime_type", "")).strip() or None
                runtimes = api.list_runtimes(runtime_type=rt_type)
                return {
                    "exec_out": True, "ok": True, "runtime_id": "",
                    "capabilities": [], "runtimes": runtimes,
                    "status": f"{len(runtimes)} runtimes",
                    "report_json": json.dumps({"count": len(runtimes)}),
                }

        except Exception as exc:
            _empty["status"] = f"error: {exc}"
            _empty["report_json"] = json.dumps({"error": str(exc)})
            return _empty

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Runtime_Federation
